declined_reason: The pause of the currencyservice causes frontend requests to hang because the frontend has no per-call deadlines or fallback for currencyservice. This is a code-level issue; configuration changes (restart policy, resources, or environment) cannot mitigate a pause-induced hang.
diagnosed_problem: Pausing currencyservice leads to 75% error rate and >3000 ms latency on Home, Product, and Cart pages. The frontend lacks per-call deadlines, so a hung dependency blocks request handling.

evidence.interpretation: Error rate far exceeds the 20% abort threshold during the pause.
95th‑percentile latency spikes above the 2000 ms abort limit.
All user‑visible pages that depend on currencyservice fail.
